_comment: Skip-list for `zig build wasi-p2-testsuite`. After PR #661 made `wamr run` AOT-only (#644), the listed fixtures fail because the AOT host bridge does not yet wire cross-instance function imports from sibling cores, and the AOT loader does not unwrap `wabt component compose` output (no core modules found). Tracked in #662. The harness `build.zig:addComponentExamples` honours `-Daot-broken-components=false` to drop these from `component-examples-run` / `wasi-p2-testsuite`; CI passes `false`. Drop entries here as #662 lands the missing AOT plumbing. Suite key matches `tests/wasi-testsuite/tests/rust/testsuite/wasm32-wasip1/manifest.json` `name` convention; format mirrors `tests/wasi-testsuite-skip.json`.
